export.checking: Checking what goes into the package…
export.nothing: There is nothing to export yet.

import.title: Import a package
import.description: Add employees, divisions and routines from a .wfos.json file. Nothing that exists is changed.
import.tooLarge: The package is larger than 2 MB.
import.willCounts: {employees, plural, one {# employee} other {# employees}}, {teams, plural, one {# division} other {# divisions}}, {routines, plural, one {# routine} other {# routines}}, {skills, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}}, {mcpSlots, plural, one {# MCP slot} other {# MCP slots}}, {memories, plural, one {# memory} other {# memories}}
import.conflictsHelp: Nothing is overwritten: these are created next to the ones you already have.
import.contentsHelp: Read what each employee will be told and remember before you import. Links and e-mail addresses are highlighted: an instruction could send data there. Imported memories are treated as untrusted.
import.egress: Hosts it may reach from its sandbox
import.done: Imported {employees, plural, one {# employee} other {# employees}}, {teams, plural, one {# division} other {# divisions}} and {routines, plural, one {# routine} other {# routines}}.

warnings.employees_draft: {count, plural, one {The employee starts} other {All # employees start}} at Draft autonomy.
warnings.tools_disabled: {count, plural, one {# tool permission is} other {# tool permissions are}} imported switched off. Turn on what each employee should use.
warnings.workspace_mode: {name} runs in Workspace mode (Claude Code in a sandbox). Check its instructions and egress domains.
warnings.routines_disabled: {count, plural, one {# routine is} other {# routines are}} imported switched off.
warnings.mcp_disabled: {count, plural, one {# MCP server is} other {# MCP servers are}} added switched off and without a token. An Owner adds the token in Settings.
warnings.mcp_renamed: MCP server {from} already exists here, so it is added as {to} and the permissions point to {to}.
warnings.mcp_unknown: Some permissions use MCP server {server}, which neither this workspace nor the package has.
warnings.skills_untrusted: {count, plural, one {# skill is} other {# skills are}} imported as untrusted: employees read them as data, not as your instructions. Read each one below.
warnings.skill_renamed: A skill named {from} already exists here, so it is added as {to}.
warnings.skill_reserved_renamed: {from} is the name of a built-in skill, so it is added as {to}.
warnings.skill_leak_findings: Skill {slug} may contain secrets or personal data ({rules}). Read it below before importing.
warnings.departments_ignored: This package was made before divisions: its departments ({count}) are not imported. Each division's SOP lives on the Divisions page.
warnings.division_head_skipped: {name} is already in division {other}, so they are not made head of {division}. An employee belongs to one division only.
warnings.division_key_taken: Division {name} is imported without its key {key}: another division here already uses it.

issues.invalid_cron: Routine {name}: the schedule is not valid ({detail}).
issues.mcp_url_not_public: MCP server {name} points to {host}, which is private, local or does not resolve. Remove it from the package or fix its URL.
issues.skill_leak: Skill {slug} contains what looks like a secret ({rules}). Remove it from the package: a skill with a secret is not imported.

rules.url-credentials: User name and password in a connection string
rules.url-userinfo: User name and password in a URL

leftOut.mcpTokens: MCP server tokens and auth headers
leftOut.toolStates: Which tools are switched on (imports start with all off)
